meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 进入 ultrawork 模式后,首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,先注册目标与成功标准、开一份只追加的记事本,再按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级,用真实界面证据和 RED→GREEN 验证交付。
howto.when: 当你请求 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在对话中时触发。动手前它会先完成勘察技能、注册目标、开记事本等四项 bootstrap 准备。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,帮我端到端实现这个功能
用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug,给我 RED→GREEN 证据
say.note: 先做等级分级,再抓真实界面证据

say.text: 开 ultrawork 模式,这次改动按 HEAVY 等级走
say.note: 覆盖正常、边界与回归三类标准

howto.what_en: In ultrawork mode Claude opens with the exact line ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, registers a goal with success criteria, keeps an append-only notepad, and proves work with RED→GREEN plus real-surface evidence, sized LIGHT or HEAVY.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request ultrawork mode and it isn't already in the conversation; before other work it completes bootstrap steps: surveying skills, registering the goal, opening a notepad.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and implement this feature end to end
say_en.note: Opens with ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then registers the goal

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this bug with RED→GREEN evidence
say_en.note: Tier triage, then real-surface evidence capture

say_en.text: Start ultrawork mode and run this change set at HEAVY tier
say_en.note: Covers happy path, edge, and regression criteria
